messages.back_svc_haircuts:
Inspiration for choosing a men's haircut. For each style you will find a description, who it suits, and suitable face shapes. You can book a specific haircut straight away.

The barber always assesses whether the style suits your head shape and hair condition. Feel free to bring an inspiration photo.
messages.back_team_members:
The Real Barber team in Prague. For each barber you will find a description, branches, favourite cuts, and client ratings.

Choose a barber by style, or first see who is working today. After opening a profile on the website you will see work samples, shifts, and free times.
messages.follow_done:
Hi! I am Rbíček, your Real Barber assistant.
Choose a topic below, or write what you need help with.
messages.main_menu: Main menu. Choose a section, or write what you need help with.
messages.menu_misc: Information about personal data protection and Real Barber customer rights.
messages.misc_menu: More information about Real Barber. Choose a topic.
messages.misc_appearance:
On the website and in the app you can adjust the look. It is a bit of a perk, but useful if you want dark mode or a different button colour.

Page look: System / Dark / Light.
Colours: your own accent colour (buttons and active elements).

Signed in: Profile → Dark or Light mode, then Colours right below.
Not signed in: Menu (bottom bar) → the same items.
On a computer the look switch is also in the top bar.
messages.interior_answer: Our men's salons in Prague have a modern interior, balanced music, and a space to relax. It is not only about the cut: we offer premium service, modern trends, and a personal approach with attention to detail.
messages.interior_web:
Real Barber s.r.o. processes personal data in line with GDPR. You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. Send requests to info@realbarber.cz or call +420 608 332 881. We usually reply within 30 days.

Deleting an app account: write to info@realbarber.cz, state the email or phone on the account and that you request deletion. We usually handle this within 5 days.
messages.gdpr_delete: To delete your Real Barber app account, write to info@realbarber.cz. State that you request account deletion, and the email or phone you use to sign in. Optionally add your first and last name for faster lookup. After verification we delete the profile and related data, usually within 5 days. We may keep some records as required by law (accounting, tax).
messages.gdpr_delete_full: Open roles are handled individually. Call +420 608 332 881 and an operator will connect you with Admin. Internships and retraining are possible by arrangement with RB Academy. Current openings are also on the website.
messages.lost_found_menu: Did you leave something with us, or find someone else's item at a branch? Choose what you need.
messages.lost_pickup:
Please report the loss to an operator, who will start handling it right away on +420 608 332 881. You can also write to info@realbarber.cz.

State the date and time of your visit, the branch, and a description of the lost item. We will then start looking for your item immediately.

An operator (live support for all branches) is available on +420 608 332 881.
messages.lost_item_more: If you find any item that seems lost, report it to colleagues at the branch, or to support on +420 608 332 881 or by email at info@realbarber.cz.
messages.lost_storage_answer:
We do not usually store lost and found items long-term at the branches. Within one working week they are typically taken to central storage.

If we conclude that a lost item has no residual value and nobody claims it, we reserve the right to dispose of it after 7 days.
messages.lost_storage_back:
We handle valuables differently. If we find an item or electronics that lets us identify you, we try to contact you even if you have not reached out.

We are not liable for lost cash or other items you bring with you.

For a lost ID document we want the rightful person to collect it (someone with the same name on the document, for example a parent). Otherwise we must hand documents in to the relevant authority.
messages.lost_valuables_back: We release items only on personal pickup. We may be willing to ship an item in individual cases, but we reserve the right to decide whether to allow it. You cover shipping costs.
messages.lost_pickup_back: Choose the situation you need help with.
messages.sit_more: More common situations. Choose what you need.
messages.sit_extra_back: What would you like to know about the branch?
messages.bf_access: The preferred directions and parking are in the How to get here video on each branch detail page. You can also use Google Maps or Waze.
messages.bf_amenities_answer: Branches have toilets, Wi-Fi, and refreshments (water / coffee). If you need anything, ask the barber team or the branch Admin.
messages.bf_pets_answer: Yes, you may bring a dog or a pram to the branch.
messages.bf_smoking_answer: Smoking classic cigarettes and IQOS is forbidden indoors. Electronic liquid cigarettes are an exception if they do not bother others.
messages.bf_cameras_answer: Each branch has 1-2 security cameras. Footage is kept for 5 days and then deleted automatically. Footage is reviewed only for an incident, theft, or damage.
messages.health_menu: Safety and health. Choose a topic.
messages.health_back: If you have a more serious illness and risk infecting others, contact an operator as soon as possible and cancel your appointment by phone or in the app. We are people and do not want to infect each other.
messages.health_hygiene_answer: Every barber uses a specific spray to clean and disinfect tools, which disinfects, cleans, lubricates, and cools them.
messages.health_injury_answer: Each branch usually has its own first-aid kit with bandages, plasters, alum, and other supplies.
messages.app_access_answer:
If for any reason you cannot access the app, contact IT support on +420 774 522 114. They will resolve it with you right away.

If confirmation of a booked appointment does not arrive, do not worry. Everything may still be fine and we may have outdated details, or you entered them incorrectly.

You can check your details yourself in Profile → Edit profile, where you will see the contacts we have for you. If they are wrong (for example you want emails at another address), you can edit them yourself.

When something does not work, write to us or call +420 608 332 881.
messages.app_access_profile: Each branch has a video showing the way to us on that branch's detail page on the website. Open the branch and play the navigation video. You can also use Google Maps or Waze.
messages.group_booking_answer: Online you can currently only book one after another. If you want to get haircuts at the same time with two barbers (friends, father and son), call +420 608 332 881. The operator can see the barbers' calendars and help you arrange it.
messages.accessibility_answer: Every branch has wheelchair access. At Kačerov use the access route from the upper part of the building. The How to get here video is on the branch detail page (parking and public transport).
messages.nerves_answer:
Before visiting a new barbershop or changing your style, you may feel nervous, and that is completely fine.

We believe communication is the basis of good work and satisfaction. If you have any feelings before or during the visit, we would love you to share them. Then we can create the best conditions so everything goes well.

No branch or barber has religious or cultural privilege. You can visit any branch.
messages.nerves_first:
If you waited at the branch more than 10 minutes past your pre-booked appointment that was reserved at least 2 hours ahead, let us know on +420 608 332 881.

If we verify it, we will try to compensate with regard to the delay.

When a barber is running late, you can call or write to us. Every piece of feedback helps us improve.
messages.filming_consent_answer: When filming or photographing, only people we asked for consent beforehand appear on the shots. If it makes you uncomfortable, let us know. Staff will stop recording immediately and, if needed, remove material you appear in.
messages.outage_answer:
If a branch cannot operate for a technical reason, we contact you as soon as we learn about it and look for a solution.

We try to offer a replacement time in full operation, at another branch, with another barber, or at the agreed branch even in reduced conditions.
messages.scam_check_answer: Our official company number is +420 608 332 881. No other phone number is our official number. If someone calls or writes in the name of Real Barber from another number, verify it with us on the official line.
messages.reminder_missing_answer: A missing reminder before an appointment is not common, but it can happen. Reach us on +420 608 332 881 and we will check and resolve it together.
messages.marketing_prefs_answer: You set marketing consents and communication preferences in your profile: Profile → Account settings → Communication preferences.
messages.marketing_gdpr:
You can leave a review for a specific barber on their detail page. Find the barber on the Team page, pick them from the list, and at the bottom you will see reviews including the option to add yours.

You can also rate a branch on the website and on Google Maps. Thank you.
messages.praise_google:
We welcome feedback on the website and the app. Ideally attach a screenshot or screen recording. That helps us understand and fix the problem.

Technical app issues are handled by IT support on +420 774 522 114. General questions: +420 608 332 881 or info@realbarber.cz.
messages.unsafe_behavior_answer: If you see a customer under the influence of drugs or behaving in a risky way, tell the branch staff so we can handle the situation appropriately.
messages.guide_menu: How can we help? Choose the situation closest to yours.
messages.guide_unhappy: Great. Browse popular haircuts, free times, or branches and the barber team.
messages.guide_haircuts: You can sort a booking in My bookings. Choose exactly what you need.
messages.guide_booking_advice: We are sorry. Choose what happened. For bookings, My bookings will help after you sign in.
messages.guide_unhappy_situations: The Real Barber (RB) app is free for iPhone and Android. Bookings at your fingertips, RB Coins, coupons, favourite barbers, waitlist, and visit history. Registration takes a few seconds via phone and SMS code.
messages.app_promo_more: What would you like to know about the app? Choose a FAQ topic.
messages.app_faq_web: Basic information about the Real Barber app.
messages.app_faq_download: The official mobile app for Real Barber clients in Prague. Use it to book haircuts and other services, manage visits, and use benefits (RB Coins, coupons, referrals). Instead of calling or messaging, you have times, history, and benefits in one place.
messages.app_faq_free_answer: Downloading and using the app is free. For booking, the RBC wallet, favourites, reviews, or the waitlist you need a free account. Registration is via phone and SMS code and usually takes a few seconds.
messages.app_faq_free_register: Enter your phone number and we send a 6-digit SMS code (valid about 10 minutes). If you already have a profile, you are signed in after verification. A new client fills in name, email, and optionally date of birth and a photo. Sign-in with phone and password is also possible.
messages.app_faq_waitlist: In the menu choose Create booking: branch, service, barber (or whoever is free), date and time, confirmation. A signed-in client has details pre-filled. You can also pick a time from Available today or from a barber's profile in one tap.
messages.app_faq_change_answer: In My bookings you will see upcoming and past visits. For an active booking you can reschedule: choose a new date and time; branch, service, and barber stay the same. You can cancel (ideally as soon as possible, no cancellation fees). Cancellation usually is not possible less than 2 hours before, and rescheduling not less than 1 hour before. After booking you can add the time to your phone calendar.
messages.waitlist_answer:
The waitlist is for when you want a specific barber on a certain day, but they currently have no free times.

You join the waitlist and tell us how to contact you. If a time frees up later, for example because another booking is cancelled, the Real Barber team contacts you and offers a booking.

The waitlist therefore does not guarantee a specific time. Its purpose is to give you a chance at a slot with your chosen barber if one opens during the day.
messages.app_faq_benefits_menu: RB Coins, coupons, and other benefits in the app.
messages.app_faq_why: RB Coins (RBC) are Real Barber loyalty credits. In the wallet you see balance and history. Coins can be transferred between customers and sent to barbers as a tip. Use them for bookings and RB STORE purchases. Staff convert a Gift Card from a branch into RB Coins for the recipient.
messages.app_faq_coupons_answer:
Coupons are most often in the app, or on Instagram @realbarber.jh. On a coupon you will see the code, validity, and description. When booking, enter the discount code and you will see the recalculated price right away.

Do not enter a physical gift voucher (Gift Card) in the form; bring it to your visit.
messages.app_faq_referral_answer: In the wallet or referrals section you will see active referral programmes: how many RBC you and your friend get, conditions, and validity. The app generates your code and share link.
messages.app_faq_why_answer: By joining now you get fast booking without phone calls, an overview of times, RB Coins and cashback, coupons, a waitlist for favourite barbers, and the ability to write reviews. The account is free; registration takes a few seconds.
messages.app_faq_push: This feature uses your phone location and shows the nearest branch: distance, estimated drive time, and nearest free times. From there you can open navigation (Google Maps or Waze) or continue to booking. Branches: Modřany, Kačerov, Hagibor, Barrandov.
messages.app_faq_favorites_answer: On a branch, barber, service, or guide, tap the heart and the item is saved to Favourites. Favourite barbers also appear in the team overview under Favourite available today.
messages.app_faq_mystyle_answer: My style is a section where you can configure past haircuts and their variants for future visits or when changing barbers.
messages.app_faq_push_answer:
In Profile, top right, there is a bell icon. Green tick = push notifications are on. Red cross = they are off: tap the bell and enable them. After correct setup you will see the green tick.

The app then reports booking status, reminders, review prompts, or RBC wallet activity.
messages.bookings_manage_menu: What do you need to sort with your booking?
messages.bm_late: After signing in you will find your times in My bookings. You can reschedule, cancel, or share a time with someone else.
messages.bookings_last_visit_guest: I opened My bookings for you.
messages.bookings_advice_menu: What exactly about the booking shall we sort out?
messages.ba_more_back: If you booked under the wrong name or phone by mistake, ideally sort it with an operator on +420 608 332 881. The operator will change the details on the booking.
messages.ba_sick_barber_answer: When a barber is ill or a shift is cancelled, we try to find a replacement that suits you best: a different barber, or a different time.
messages.ba_status_answer:
You will find booking status after signing in under My bookings. Open the time in detail: you will see the number, price, barber, navigation to the branch, and status (upcoming, in progress, past, cancelled).

Cannot see the time? Write to info@realbarber.cz or call +420 608 332 881.
messages.ba_no_confirm_answer:
Booking confirmation goes to the email you entered when ordering. The booking itself is still saved in your account.

Sign in with the phone number you used when booking. In My bookings you will see your time just like your other bookings.

You can check your details yourself in Profile → Edit profile, where you will see the contacts we have for you. If they are wrong (for example you want emails at another address), you can edit them yourself.

If you cannot sign in or something does not work, call +420 608 332 881.
messages.ba_no_confirm_call:
Cancel a booking in the time detail with the Cancel button. Cancelling frees the slot for others. We do not charge cancellation fees, but please let us know as early as you can (ideally at least 2 days ahead). Online cancellation usually is not possible less than 2 hours before the agreed time.

Cannot do it online? Call +420 608 332 881.
messages.ba_move_answer:
Reschedule in the booking detail with the Reschedule button. Branch, service, and barber stay the same; only date and time change.

Cannot do it online? Call +420 608 332 881.
messages.ba_share_answer:
By sending a link you can share the time, barber, and branch with anyone. The shared link does not include your name, booking price, or contact details.

In the booking detail for that time choose Share booking detail. Sharing works for upcoming and in-progress times, not past or cancelled ones.
messages.ba_share_recipient_answer:
The recipient opens your link (without signing in).

They will see:
- time status (scheduled, in progress, completed, or cancelled)
- barber name and photo
- branch, address, and navigation (Maps / Waze)
- date and time from-to
- Add to calendar button

They will not see your name, booking price, or contact details.

After the visit ends or after cancellation the link stops working.
messages.ba_change_answer:
Rescheduling does not change the barber or branch. If you want a different barber or branch (Modřany, Kačerov, Hagibor, Barrandov), cancel the current booking and create a new one.

We are happy to help you choose on +420 608 332 881.
messages.ba_late_answer:
Being up to 5 minutes late is usually fine. For a longer delay call an operator on +420 608 332 881. They will help based on current options (shortening, rescheduling, another solution).

If you arrive early, it depends on how busy we are. If the barber finished earlier, they may take you earlier.
messages.ba_late_move:
Create a new booking from free times or by phone (+420 608 332 881). Ideally at least 3 days ahead. Open every day including holidays. Mon-Fri 9-21, Sat-Sun 10-18.

Two people at the same time: call an operator who can see the barbers' calendars. A recurring booking (e.g. every 4 weeks) is set up by arrangement with a specific barber.
messages.ba_book_link: We will show your last visit after loading data from your account. Soon you will see it here in chat.
messages.last_visit_guest: You will see your last visit after signing in. Sign in for faster booking management and visit history.
messages.last_visit_login: How exactly can I help you regarding satisfaction?
messages.sat_other: That makes us very happy! We would love a review. Were you happier with the branch, or with a specific barber?
messages.sat_happy_back:
On the team page pick a barber and open their profile. After signing in you can write a review on the profile and rate the visit.

Want to thank the whole branch? Leave a Google review. The link by branch is below.
messages.sat_happy_barber_back: I opened the team page. Click a barber, open the profile, and after signing in you can add a review there.
messages.sat_happy_team_google: Thank you! Choose a branch and leave a Google review. It helps other customers and our team.
messages.sat_happy_branch_back: Thank you for the review! It helps us a lot. Reach out anytime, Rbíček is here for you.
messages.sat_result_answer:
We guarantee satisfaction. For a more serious issue the customer does not pay for the service.

A complaint the next day gives a better chance to find and fix the problem. After a week the haircut already looks different because hair grows.

Feedback without a complaint: SMS to +420 608 332 881.
messages.sat_complaint_answer: Write the date and time, name, branch, service, and what happened. Reach us on +420 608 332 881 (call / SMS) or info@realbarber.cz. Preferred channel order: call, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram.
messages.sat_other_answer: Please describe the problem in your own words, or choose a situation below. You can also contact us on +420 608 332 881.
messages.sat_other_situations: What would you like to know about RB Coins and the app?
messages.app_account: You will find the Real Barber app in the App Store (iPhone) and Google Play (Android). The website also has a download page with a QR code.
messages.app_download_web: RB Coins are loyalty credits in the Real Barber wallet. Pay with them for services and RB STORE products. Staff convert a Gift Card from a branch into Coins on the recipient's account.
messages.app_coins_faq:
You can buy a gift voucher (Gift Card) at every branch. It has no expiry and is valid for all services at all branches.

On site we convert the credit into RB Coins for the recipient. A voucher can also be split among several people. Coins can be used for services and RB STORE.

When booking online, do not enter the physical card in the form. Bring it to the branch and we will redeem it during the visit.
messages.app_account_answer:
The same account works on the website and in the app: history, favourites, wallet. We keep visit history with no time limit.

An operator changes the phone number on an account manually on +420 608 332 881.
messages.app_account_delete: What information about services are you looking for?
messages.svc_result_care: Choose a topic about the service result.
messages.svc_photos: The barber will recommend and suggest options that are currently possible on the spot. Feel free to bring an inspiration photo, but they will advise without one too.
messages.svc_beard_answer: We do beard shaping and shaving with hot-steam steaming.
messages.svc_beard_price: We offer colouring and hair styling with styling products. You can also buy styling products on site.
messages.svc_same_day_fix_answer: It mainly depends on the consultation at the start. If anything is unclear, ask before the service begins. It is not awkward to double-check with a question. The goal is that you and the barber understand the desired result the same way.
messages.svc_same_day_sat: Ask your barber about home care. They will advise you individually on what to do and how (washing, product, visit frequency).
messages.svc_allergy_answer: If you have had negative experiences before (for example irritation after a straight-razor shave), tell the barber before the service starts.
messages.svc_photos_answer: The barber always asks whether you consent to photos. They may also cover the face in the photo. If you do not consent, they will not take before and after photos and will respect your decision.
messages.svc_price_answer: The current price list is on the website, in the app, and before you finish a booking. Prices are the same at all branches. Pay by cash or card, with no hidden extras.
messages.svc_price_link: We offer haircuts, quick cuts, beard work, steaming shaves, children's cuts, colouring, and styling. We also cut women's hair with a focus on men's styles. Service length details are under How long does a service take.
messages.svc_list_link:
Every barber has a website profile with a photo and work description. Choose by style, languages, and availability. If your barber is not free, we try to find a suitable temporary replacement.

For juniors / trainees the customer is always informed in advance (online and by phone).
messages.svc_barber_link: Open every day including holidays under normal opening hours. Mon-Fri 9-21, Sat-Sun 10-18. All branches the same. We announce extraordinary closures on social media and the website. Contact: +420 608 332 881, info@realbarber.cz.
messages.svc_first_answer:
Ideally book at least 3 days ahead. You will then very likely get a great time. Sometimes it works the same day (even 2 hours ahead), other times only in 1-2 days. It depends how busy the barber is.

Just arrive 5-10 minutes early, or right on time. You do not need to bring anything essential. At most a phone with a photo of a past cut or inspiration.

Flow: arrival → consultation (5-10 min, included in the service) → service → summary and maintenance tips → payment → leave.
messages.svc_first_link: What would you like to know about a first visit?
messages.fv_duration: Walk-in without a booking is possible, but booked customers always have priority. On quieter days, if a barber is free, they may take a walk-in. Before starting the service they must enter the booking in the system.
messages.fv_kids_answer:
We cut children's hair at any age if they already have experience with haircuts and can handle it. Some manage at 2, others not at 4.

Under 12 a parent companion is better. Children who visit us regularly and are used to it may also come without a parent.
messages.fv_women_answer: We also cut women's hair, but we focus on men's styles. It is better to consult first at the branch with barbers who specialise in longer hair, and book a specific barber. There is no ban on women entering.
messages.fv_companion_answer: You may bring a companion. Each branch has capacity for roughly 2-5 people waiting. Booked customers may also be in the waiting area, so bringing the whole family is not ideal.
messages.fv_languages_answer: Each barber's languages are on their website profile. Some speak English, some Ukrainian, some only Czech. If possible, another barber can help with a consultation in another language.
messages.fv_languages_web:
Classic haircut: 45 minutes.
Quick cut (no wash): 30 minutes.
Beard: 30 minutes.
Hair and beard: 75-90 minutes.
Children's cut: 30 minutes.

Several services in one booking are possible by arrangement based on availability. Quieter times can be sorted with the barber on site, or by phone with an operator.
messages.svc_duration_price: Services outside a regular salon visit. What are you interested in?
messages.outside_business: What type of out-of-salon service is it?
messages.evt_school: A barber can come to your home. Price depends on distance, travel, and the specific service. Arrange by phone on +420 608 332 881. Also possible outside normal hours.
messages.evt_home_link: Real Barber can come to a wedding, party, or company event. Arrange the date, number of people, and place by phone, or we will connect you with an operator.
messages.evt_party_business: We offer a seminar for students in years 1-3. It helps understand basic cutting techniques, entrepreneurship, and career building. Contact: info@realbarber.cz or +420 608 332 881.
messages.business_menu: What would you like to know about working with companies?
messages.biz_back_outside: Real Barber can come to a company event or team building. Arrange the date, number of people, and place by phone (+420 608 332 881), or we will connect you with an operator.
messages.biz_event_events: For companies we offer regular employee care at the branch or at your premises. Write to info@realbarber.cz or call +420 608 332 881.
messages.biz_invoice_answer: We handle company invoicing at info@realbarber.cz. Include company ID (IČO), number of people, and the required scope of services.
messages.biz_contact_answer: Contact sales at info@realbarber.cz or +420 608 332 881. We are happy to prepare a tailored offer.
messages.payments_menu: What exactly about payments shall we sort out?
messages.pay_invoice: All branches accept cash and card. Prices are the same everywhere per the current price list. After a card payment the barber will offer you a receipt on the spot.
messages.pay_double_answer: If you were charged twice, contact us immediately. We will start resolving it and, if the claim is valid, you get the money back at once. Reach us on +420 608 332 881. Thank you, and we believe it was only a mistake.
messages.pay_tip_answer: If you leave a tip for branch staff, it cannot be refunded after you leave.
messages.pay_coupon_issue_answer:
If a coupon will not apply, it is either already inactive, used up, or you are not eligible.

Important: if you cancel a booking made with a coupon, we treat the coupon as already used.
messages.pay_invoice_answer: If you need an invoice, write to info@realbarber.cz or call +420 608 332 881. We will send the invoice to the contact you give us. You get a card receipt on the spot after payment.
messages.operator_host_support: We opened support contact. In the sheet choose phone, WhatsApp, or Telegram. You can also continue below.
messages.operator_live: After your question we will connect you with an operator. Please write what you need help with.
messages.operator_off_hours: Live support is off now (Mon-Fri 8:30-21:30, Sat-Sun 9:30-18:30). Meanwhile call +420 608 332 881 or write to info@realbarber.cz.
messages.off_hours_mail: Connecting to an operator did not work just now. Please try again, or call +420 608 332 881 / info@realbarber.cz.
messages.unavailable_call: We are preparing the connection to an operator. Meanwhile contact us on +420 608 332 881 or info@realbarber.cz.
messages.goodbye: Thank you! Reach out anytime. Rbíček is here for you.
messages.goodbye_joke: I have a joke for you.
messages.goodbye_joke_more: I have a joke for you.
messages.goodbye_joke_alt_menu: I expect questions about Real Barber. Choose a topic below or contact us.
messages.free_text_placeholder: We are still working on free-text questions. Rbíček will handle them soon. For now please choose an option from the menu.
messages.free_text_menu: I am still here. Choose a topic or write a question.

messageLoggedIn.bm_late: You will find your times in My bookings. You can reschedule, cancel, or share a time with someone else.
